nativeComparisons.compares: 422 byte-exact outputs against native run at test time (batched: one native call per input writes all its outputs): 240 over 48 synthesized files (qualities 0-3 x 8000/22050 Hz x 0-4 blocks with lone-bitmask, partial-sample and near-full truncated tails; copy framecrc, s16le decode framecrc, WAV, copy raw, s32le raw); 54 layout outputs over 12 positions (FC, -0.0, FL, FR, SL, SR, LFE, LFE 255, unmatched, raised, NaN, near-miss) as WAV, copy WAV, s16le and u8 raw plus copy framecrc for the 6 mono positions; 127 timing outputs (output -ss/-t/-frames:a, declared -f laf, -ss past the end, copy and decode framecrc and WAV; declared wrong LIMITLESS); 1 empty stream at the largest f32le rate. In addition, native's channel_layout_name is asserted for 12 positions and native exit statuses for 15 error cases (183 for header failures; 0 for multi-stream and zero bitmasks with native's demux error asserted), 2 undeclared-detection cases (0 with .laf, 183 with .bin), input -ss (0) and the missing laf muxer.

unsupported: files with st_count > 1 (native exposes one mono stream per channel and maps one); refused
input -ss (laf_read_seek returns -1, generic index seek); refused
a stored bitmask with bit 0 clear, in any block including the dropped tail (native demux error mid-stream, exit 0); refused up front
framecrc output for FL/FR/SL/SR/LFE single-speaker layouts: the existing PCM path refuses them (Unknown channel mask for framecrc output); WAV and raw match native
detection by the .laf extension alone when the probe fails (native extension fallback); refused unless -f laf
FLAC-path and Workers-runtime evidence (no tests/workers file)

proposedContracts.name: maps quality to codec and the stream position to a single-channel mask as laf_read_header does
proposedContracts.scope: Quality 0-3 to pcm_u8/s16le/f32le/s24le, the float == layout chain (FC, FL, FR, SL, SR, LFE; -0.0 equal to 0; NaN, infinity and near misses mono), mode 0/1 accepted, header duration ignored. Synthetic inputs, no native run.

proposedContracts.name: reads the header in bounded reads, checks one bitmask byte per block and drops a truncated final block
proposedContracts.scope: 3-byte reads that touch only the header and one bitmask byte per block; block reader offsets with startSample and 6-byte packet budgets; truncated tails dropped. Synthetic inputs.

proposedContracts.name: refuses malformed headers with native INVALIDDATA, multi-stream files, zero bitmasks and bad budgets
proposedContracts.scope: Every header refusal with exit 183, rate limits at both edges for f32le and u8, st_count 2 and 4096 refused as unimplemented, zero bitmasks in first, middle and tail blocks, budgets and short or long reads.

proposedContracts.name: matches native LAF copy and decode framecrc, WAV and raw for four qualities at 8000 and 22050 Hz with 0 to 4 blocks and truncated tails
proposedContracts.scope: 48 synthesized single-stream files x 5 outputs byte-exact against the reference built at test time (commit 946fcce0, --disable-x86asm). Integer and -cpuflags 0 float paths, all platforms.

proposedContracts.name: matches native LAF channel layouts for FC, FL, FR, SL, SR, LFE, -0.0 and unmatched positions in WAV and raw, and refuses non-mono framecrc as before
proposedContracts.scope: 12 positions: WAV (WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE masks), copy WAV and raw byte-exact; copy framecrc for mono positions; native layout names asserted; single-speaker framecrc refused by the PCM path before output.

proposedContracts.name: matches native LAF packet timing for output -ss, -t and -frames:a, declared -f laf and a header duration
proposedContracts.scope: Rate-sample packet rows under output -ss/-t/-frames:a and declared -f laf, copy and fixed-volume decode to framecrc and WAV. No input -ss (refused).

proposedContracts.name: refuses malformed, multi-stream and seeking LAF before any output and records native exit statuses
proposedContracts.scope: 15 malformed or unsupported inputs with native exit statuses asserted; EdgeFFmpeg exits 183 or 1 and opens no output. Also the largest f32le rate, input -ss refusal and the absence of a muxer.

notes: Setup durations: bootstrap (npm 8.8 s, submodule 7.3 s, reference build 210.6 s) 226.6 s total; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+container registry unit tests 78 s. The first bootstrap attempt failed immediately because the sandbox default Node was v22.23.5; /opt/node24 (v24.22.3) was used for everything afterwards.
The differential file runs in about 8 s with --maxWorkers=1 on 4 vCPUs.
The reference binary differs from the linux-x64 pin (built with --allow-unpinned-reference); the tests assert only the commit and --disable-x86asm from build-metadata.json and never pin a binary sha.

Mono (FC or any unmatched position) is reported with channelMask null like the other single-channel demuxers; single-speaker layouts are reported as their masks, which the WAV muxer writes as WAVEFORMATEXTENSIBLE exactly as native does.

Framecrc of single-speaker layouts would need the PCM path's framecrc layout table to name masks such as '1 channels (FL)'; that is a shared edit outside this item and is not requested here, the refusal stands.
No errno-based native status is involved: every LAF header refusal is AVERROR_INVALIDDATA (183) on every host.
No linux-gated cases: the module does byte copies and integer arithmetic only; f32le samples reach the existing PCM conversions under -cpuflags 0.
